verdict.rationale: Cursor Cloud Agents run in isolated cloud VMs with full development environments, and the Cloud Agents API lets you route runs to Cursor-hosted VMs or your own pool/machine workers and pass session-scoped encrypted envVars. Self-Hosted Machines also let agent tool execution happen on a machine you manage. The evidence does not document a declarative, repo-committed cloud environment definition (dependency install, setup or startup steps, snapshots). The `.cursor/worktrees.json` setup scripts apply to local worktrees, not cloud VMs, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: documented repo-level cloud environment config for dependencies and setup steps, reproducibility/snapshot guarantees, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure a reproducible cloud environment with the dependencies and setup steps my repository needs

citations.quote: run in isolated VMs in the cloud with full development environments
`env` routing to Cursor-hosted VMs or your own `pool`/`machine` workers
Self-Hosted Machines moves Cloud Agent tool execution to a machine you manage
